metadata.title: Civ13 train collision fix: locomotives stop and coupled wagons follow (PR #3032)
metadata.description: Original sampled native Dream Seeker footage for Civ13 PR #3032, captured at ad0c9ce9847dbad62fe0d636134250310cf5c95b with BYOND 516.1681, NOMADS 155x225x2. Two powered steam locomotives approach, one towing two flatbeds. They stop adjacent at (27,22,1) and (28,22,1); native logs report health 995 and automovement 0. This is an 11.4-second local verification scene built from 25 timed native captures, not a production-server recording or continuous frame-rate benchmark. No audio or added imagery. The captured revision was rebased out of the final PR history; scoped source equivalence and successful tests are separate evidence, not Git ancestry. Startup bad-reference diagnostics and later resource-guard termination are disclosed; the clip does not establish a production hard crash or clean full-game runtime. Source: https://github.com/Civ13/Civ13/pull/3032#issuecomment-6107678670 ; scoped equivalence: https://github.com/Civ13/Civ13/pull/3032#issuecomment-6107755107
